mechanism: Both drugs increase serotonergic activity through different mechanisms (SNRI and MAOI), creating risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and sympathomimetic potentiation.
action: This combination is contraindicated; allow minimum 14-day washout from tranylcypromine before starting venlafaxine, or 7 days from venlafaxine before starting tranylcypromine, and monitor closely for serotonin syndrome and hypertensive crisis.
